name: nexus-mcp
description: Fewer tokens for Cursor on large codebases. Local hybrid code search, a call graph for 10 languages and the code of any symbol, so the agent reads fewer files. In the 2.4.1 benchmark it used 27% to 49% fewer tokens than Grep and Read on Django and Home Assistant. Runs on your machine through uv: no API key, no telemetry.
